brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: structure.read
objective.description: Read one structure descriptor from the local context with selectable meaning, functional, and brique sections.

#root.role: Resolve one structure identifier, read the local structure descriptor, and return the requested sections.

want_meaning._comment: Optional. When true (default), includes the meaning section of the descriptor. Set to false to exclude it.

want_functional._comment: Optional. When true (default), includes the functional section of the descriptor. Set to false to exclude it.

want_brique._comment: Optional. When true (default), includes the brique section of the descriptor. Set to false to exclude it.

effects.structure_descriptor: The local structure descriptor file is read.

transformation_contract.morphing: A structure identifier plus section selectors becomes an explicit structure view assembled from the local descriptor and catalog projection.
invariants: structure.read never mutates the addressed structure.
Only descriptor sections are returned; no structure payload or matter substance is exposed here.
success: A successful response always includes structure_id and every requested descriptor section that could be read.
The returned sections are assembled from the local catalog projection and structure descriptor file.
failure: The capacity fails when structure_id is missing or the addressed structure is absent from the runtime catalog.
The capacity fails when the catalog entry is not actually a structure or when the descriptor cannot be read.
notes: All three selector booleans default to true when omitted: omitting all of them returns the full descriptor.
Unlike matter.read, structure.read uses want_* booleans directly and does not support read_mode.
structure.read is descriptor-focused and does not expose a substance payload.
